#!/bin/bash

# Log file path
LOG_FILE="/workspace/network_log.txt"

# Function to check network connectivity
check_network() {
    if ping -c 1 8.8.8.8 &> /dev/null; then
        echo "
$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') - UP - Network is reachable" >> "$LOG_FILE"
    else
        echo "
$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') - DOWN - Network is not reachable" >> "$LOG_FILE"
    fi
}

# Infinite loop to check network every minute
while true; do
    check_network
    sleep 60
}

#!/bin/bash

# Log file path
LOG_FILE="/tmp/mcp-workspace/network_log.txt"

# Function to check network connectivity
check_network() {
    if ping -c 1 8.8.8.8 &> /dev/null; then
        echo "$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') - UP - Network is reachable" >> "$LOG_FILE"
    else
        echo "$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') - DOWN - Network is not reachable" >> "$LOG_FILE"
    fi
}

# Infinite loop to check network every minute

    check_network
    sleep 60
